in_hebrew.name: טל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם 'טל' מקורו במילה העברית 'טל', שפירושה טל הבוקר, לחלוחיות שיורדות מן השמיים על האדמה. הוא סמלי לחידוש, לרעננות ולברכה. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם 'טל' יכול לייצג את הטל הרוחני, שפירושו ברכה והשראה אלוהית.

in_greek.name: Δ露
in_greek.meaning: Δ露 σημαίνει ανανέωση και πνευματική χάρη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα 'Δ露' προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη για τη δροσιά, που συμβολίζει την ανανέωση, τη φρεσκάδα και τη χάρη. Στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία, η δροσιά ήταν σύμβολο της πνευματικής χάρης και της ανανέωσης που έρχεται από τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Dew
in_latin.meaning: Dew significat mane stillans et spiritualis gratia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen 'Dew' a Latina voce 'dew' derivatur, quae mane stillans seu ros indicat. In traditione Christiana, 'Dew' est symbolum gratiae spiritualis, renovationis et inspirationis divinae, quae corda hominum illustrat.

in_english.name: Dew
in_english.meaning: Dew represents spiritual refreshment and divine blessing
in_english.long_meaning: The name 'Dew' originates from the Hebrew word 'טל' (Tal), meaning 'dew'. It symbolizes spiritual refreshment, divine blessing, and renewal. In the Bible, dew is often associated with God's blessings and mercy. Throughout Christian tradition, 'Dew' has been used to signify the refreshing presence of God and the hope of spiritual rejuvenation.

biblical_reference.note: In Psalm 110:3, 'dew' symbolizes divine blessing and fertility.

data.cultural_impact: In Indonesia, the word "Dewa" means 'god' or 'deity' in their Indonesian language.
data.spiritual_significance: Dew as a name can also represent a connection to the divine or a reminder of the spiritual nature of all things.

historical_references.reference: The name Dew has been used throughout Christian history by saints, scholars, and faithful believers who exemplified its meaning.
